common.serverError: The request could not be completed right now.
common.serverErrorAction: Check your connection and try again shortly; if it keeps happening, tell your administrator.

login.title: Sign in
login.invalidAction: Check your details and try again. If you forgot your password, reset it.
login.demoBanner: Demo environment — do not enter real personal data

reset.requestIntro: Enter your account email address. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes and works once.
reset.sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has been sent. If it does not arrive in a few minutes, ask your administrator for a reset link.
reset.undeliverable: We cannot send reset links by email right now. Ask your administrator for a reset link: they can generate a one-time link for you from the members screen and pass it on.
reset.passwordHint: At least 12 and at most 128 characters.
reset.mismatchAction: Type the same password in both fields.
reset.passwordRule: The password does not meet the length rule.
reset.passwordRuleAction: Choose a password of 12 to 128 characters.
reset.invalidLink: The reset link is invalid, already used, or expired.
reset.invalidLinkAction: Request a new link or ask your administrator to generate one.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. For your safety all sessions were closed; sign in with the new password.

mfa.verifyIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.backupIntro: Enter one of the backup codes you saved during setup. Each code works only once.
mfa.invalid: The code is wrong or expired.
mfa.invalidAction: Type the current code from the app again.
mfa.locked: Too many wrong codes; verification is temporarily locked.
mfa.setupIntro: Connect an authenticator app to protect your account. This step is mandatory for administrator accounts.
mfa.confirmPasswordHint: Type your password again for security.
mfa.passwordWrongAction: Check your password and try again.
mfa.keyTitle: 1. Add the key to the app
mfa.keyIntro: Add a new account in your authenticator app and type this key manually.
mfa.backupWarning: These codes are shown only now. If you lose your phone they are the only way in; store them somewhere safe.
mfa.setupDone: Two-step verification is enabled. Next time you sign in you will be asked for the app code.
mfa.demoDisabled: Two-step verification cannot be set up in the demo environment.
mfa.demoDisabledAction: Sign in with your real account to set it up.
mfa.alreadyEnabledAction: If you need to change it, contact your administrator.

signOut.label: Sign out
signOut.failedAction: Check your connection and try again.

invite.title: Workspace invitation
invite.intro: To accept the invitation, enter your name and choose a password. Your account is created with this invitation.
invite.introSignedIn: You are about to accept this invitation with the account you are signed in with.
invite.name: Your name
invite.haveAccount: I already have an account, sign in

errors.not_found: The invitation was not found, has expired, or was revoked.
errors.not_foundAction: Ask the administrator who invited you for a new invitation.
errors.forbidden: This invitation cannot be accepted with this account; it may have been sent to a different email address.
errors.forbiddenAction: Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to, or ask the administrator to invite the right address.
errors.validation_failedAction: Check your name and a password of at least 12 characters, then try again.
errors.rate_limitedAction: Wait a moment and try again.
errors.mfa_required: Two-step verification is required for this invitation.
errors.mfa_requiredAction: Set up two-step verification first, then open the invitation again.

members.title: Members
members.intro: People who can work in this workspace.
members.lockedReason: You do not have permission for this. Ask your manager.
members.unavailableReason: This action is not available for this person. They can reset their own password with their own email.
members.empty: There are no members in this workspace yet.

role.title: Change role?
role.description: {name} will work as {role} in this workspace from now on; their permissions change accordingly.

remove.title: Remove member?
remove.description: {name} will no longer be able to work in this workspace. Past records are kept.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership?
transfer.description: {name} becomes the owner of this workspace; you lose the owner privilege.

reset.title: Create a reset link?
reset.description: A single-use link valid for 30 minutes is created for {name}. You will see it only once and must pass it on yourself.

pending.title: Pending invitations
pending.revokeDescription: {email} will not be able to join with this link.
pending.locked: Only people who can manage members can see pending invitations.

inviteDialog.title: Invite a member
inviteDialog.emailHint: The invitation goes to this address.
inviteDialog.sentEmail: The invitation was sent by email. It is valid for 72 hours.
inviteDialog.sentScreen: The invitation email could not be sent. Pass the link below on to the person you invited.

linkBox.copyFailedAction: Select the link and copy it manually.
linkBox.warning: Pass this link only to the person you invited; it will not be shown again.
linkBox.resetWarning: Pass this link only to the person concerned; it will not be shown again. It is valid for 30 minutes and works once.

errors.forbiddenAction: Check your permission. If the person is the workspace owner, first transfer ownership to another administrator.
errors.forbidden_mfa_required: Two-step verification is required for administrator actions.
errors.forbidden_mfa_requiredAction: Set up two-step verification first, then repeat the action.
errors.unauthenticatedAction: Sign in again and repeat the action.
errors.unauthenticated_recent_auth_required: You need to confirm your identity again for this action.
errors.unauthenticated_recent_auth_requiredActi: Sign in again and repeat the action.
errors.not_found: Record not found; someone else may have changed it.
errors.not_foundAction: Reload the page and try again.
errors.validation_failed: The information entered is not valid.
errors.validation_failedAction: Check the email address and role, then try again.
errors.version_conflict: The record was changed by another action at the same time.
errors.version_conflictAction: Reload the page and try again.
errors.rate_limitedAction: Wait a moment and try again.
errors.tenant_closingAction: Contact support if you need to export your data.
errors.internal: The action could not be completed right now.
errors.internalAction: Try again shortly; if it continues, tell your administrator with the error code.

members.demoLocked: This action is disabled for the demo account.
